'''Fudbalski klub Sloga Doboj''' ({{lang-sr-cyr|ФК Слога Добој}}), also known as '''Sloga Meridian''' for sponsorship reasons,<ref>{{cite web | last= | first= | title= Regionalni lider u razvoju sporta: Kompanija Meridianbet najveći sponzor klubova i Saveza!| website=Novosti| date=4 February 2024 | url=https://www.novosti.rs/sport/fudbal/1329145/regionalni-lider-razvoju-sporta-kompanija-meridianbet-najveci-sponzor-klubova-saveza| access-date=29 May 2024}}</ref> is an [[association football]] club from the city of [[Doboj]] in northern [[Republika Srpska]], an entity of [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. The club competes in the [[Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina]] and plays its home matches at Stadion Luke, which has a capacity of 3,000."}}
